title: Kiangsu Provincial Food Provisions And Fuel Adjustment Department

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
Section 1, Special Branch. Shanghai.
REPORT
Date September 19, 1937.
Subject Kiangsu Provincial Food Provisions and Fuel Adjustment Department.
Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by C. Gandon

The Kiangsu Provincial Food Provisions and Fuel Adjustment
Department is a sub-organ of the Kiangsu Provincial Government,
and has its main offices in Chinkiang. This department
is entrusted by the Provincial Government with the task of
effecting control over all hongs and merchants dealing in
food provisions and fuel as well as the registration of all
imports and exports of commodities. To facilitate the work
of the department, branch offices have been established at
Sungkiang, Tsingpu, Soochow, Wusieh and Changchow. The Chief
Officer in charge of this organ is one Tsoh Bing ( 祝 平 ),
aged about 36, native of Tungchow, Kiangsu, ex-Chief of the
Land Bureau at Nanking. He is a member of the Central
Kuomintang Headquarters and also a close follower of Mr. Chen
Lih-fu ( 陳 立 夫 ), Chairman of the Central Kuomintang
Headquarters.

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.
（印：20 SEP. 1937）
D.C. (Crime & Special Branches)
（印：20 SEP. 1937）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ____
第一科，特别支部。上海。
报告
日期：1937年9月19日。
主题：江苏省粮食与燃料调整委员会。
呈报人：侦探督察潘连璧（Pan Lien-pih） 转呈人：C. Gandon

江苏省粮食与燃料调整委员会是江苏省政府的一个下属机构，其主要办事处设在镇江。该委员会受省政府委托，负责对所有经营粮食和燃料的商号及商人实施管制，并登记所有商品的进出口。为便利该委员会的工作，已在松江、青浦、苏州、无锡和常州设立了分支机构。主管该机构的首席官员是祝平（Tsoh Bing），约36岁，江苏通州人，曾任南京地政局局长。他是国民党中央执行委员会成员，也是国民党中央执行委员会主席陈立夫先生的亲信追随者。

潘连璧
侦探督察
（印：1937年9月20日）
副 commissioner（刑事科与特别支部）
（印：1937年9月20日）

page_data.en:
September 16, 1937.    4    Afternoon Translation

KIANGSU FOOD AND FUEL SUPPLIES TO BE REGULATED

The following circular notice appears in
the advertisement columns of the "Ta Kung Pao" and other
local newspapers to-day :-
"With a view to securing control and adjust-
ment of food provisions and fuel in the province of
Kiangsu, this Department has enforced a set of measures
relating to the control of all hongs and merchants dealing
in food provisions and fuel as well as the registration of
all the imports and exports of food provisions and fuel.
Henceforth, all the official organs and public bodies
outside the sphere of this province which desire to purchase
and transport food provisions and fuel from this province
should make necessary arrangements with this Department
beforehand.

"Tsoh Bing (祝平)
"Chief of the Kiangsu Provincial
Food Provisions and Fuel Adjust-
ment Department."

S1 / Disk    7/1    C.o.s.d    G 4/7
page_data.zh:
1937年9月16日。    4    下午译件

江苏省粮食与燃料供应将受管制

今日《大公报》及其他本地报纸的广告栏刊登了以下通函通知：
“为确保对江苏省内粮食和燃料的控制与调整，本委员会已实施一套措施，涉及对所有经营粮食和燃料的商号及商人的管制，以及所有粮食和燃料进出口的登记。此后，凡本省范围外的所有官方机关和公共团体欲从本省购买和运输粮食及燃料者，应事先与本委员会作出必要安排。

“祝平（Tsoh Bing）
“江苏省粮食与燃料调整委员会
“主任。”

S1 / Disk    7/1    C.o.s.d    G 4/7
